description:
One call → 3-10 parallel searches across Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo → dedup → extracts full content from top sources → returns CITED SOURCE MATERIAL (numbered passages), not a written answer. Extractive, not generative — you compose the final answer from the gathered passages.

**Use for:** complex questions needing passages from ≥3 independent sources in one call — comparative analysis, market research, technical deep dives, competitive intelligence. Replaces 5-10 manual search+extract calls.
**Not for:** a single fact or one URL (novada_search — faster/cheaper), a known URL (novada_extract), or a finished prose report (this returns source material, not an answer).
**Depth:** "quick" (3 queries), "deep" (6), "comprehensive" (8-9), "auto" (default — quick or deep by question length, never comprehensive).
**Project grouping:** `project="my-project"` groups outputs under a subfolder.
**Recency:** `time_range` ("day"|"week"|"month"|"year"), `start_date`/`end_date` (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) propagate to every internal search call.
**Response size:** extracts full content from the top 5 sources only (even at depth="comprehensive"); each source is capped at novada_extract's own default 25,000-char limit — bounded total, not unbounded "every source in full."

depth.description: 'quick'=3 searches, 'deep'=6, 'comprehensive'=8-9, 'auto' (default)=picks quick or deep by question length — never comprehensive.

end_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Return results published on or before this date.

focus.description: Optional focus area to guide sub-query generation. E.g. 'technical implementation', 'business impact', 'recent news only'.

project.description: Group outputs in a subfolder, e.g. 'france-vs-norway'. Local stdio only — no effect on hosted.

query.description: REQUIRED — provide either `question` or `query`. Alias for `question` — use either.

question.description: REQUIRED — provide either `question` or `query`. The research question to answer (min 5 characters).

start_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Return results published on or after this date.

time_range.description: Limit results to a time window. 'day'=last 24h, 'week'=last 7 days, 'month'=last 30 days, 'year'=last 12 months.

name: novada_research
title: Deep Research
